links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level of chatbot answers about exercise in pulmonary arterial hypertension
links.effect: FKGL was 9.09 ± 1.87 for ChatGPT, 8.79 ± 1.35 for DeepSeek and 10.91 ± 1.23 for Gemini (p = 0.011), so responses read at roughly 9th to 11th grade level.
links.quote: The readability scores of ChatGPT (9.09 ± 1.87) and DeepSeek (8.79 ± 1.35) were similar, Gemini's score (10.91 ± 1.23) higher than that of other chatbots (p = 0.011).

screen.reason: The study evaluates and compares the accuracy and readability of three commercial LLMs (ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek) answering patient questions about pulmonary arterial hypertension, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
